# Openhook

Self-hosted event inboxes for AI agents. Openhook operates its own HTTP, SMTP,
and authoritative DNS listeners with durable SQLite storage.

MCP: https://openhook.dev/mcp (Streamable HTTP)
Browser: https://openhook.dev/app
Setup: https://openhook.dev/connect
Live tool schemas: https://openhook.dev/api/tools
Source: https://github.com/openhook-dev/openhook-inbox

create_webhook returns a private ohk_ management token and public capture
addresses. Keep the token private; capture addresses cannot read stored events.
Email and DNS addresses are present when their listeners are configured.
wait_for_request and wait_for_email wait up to 120 seconds. Pass next_since
when reconnecting. Inboxes expire within seven days, retaining the latest 1000
events, each at most 1 MB. 26 native MCP tools are available.
